name: move-tabs-and-groups
description: Move tabs and tab groups around using keyboard shortcuts

scripts.zip: rm -fv move-tabs-and-groups.zip && pushd dist && zip -r ../move-tabs-and-groups.zip . ; popd
scripts.zip-firefox: rm -fv move-tabs-and-groups-firefox.zip && pushd dist-firefox && zip -r ../move-tabs-and-groups-firefox.zip . ; popd
scripts.build-and-zip: npm run build && npm run zip
scripts.build-and-zip-firefox: npm run build-firefox && npm run zip-firefox

author: Jackson McKay
